classes.DEVELOPING: At least 15 prospective observations or historical OOS pass, but decisive STRONG evidence not yet established.
classes.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Evidence below minimum, unavailable, or metrics sealed by governance.
classes.NO_GO: Formal governance rejection or statistically decisive underperformance versus reference.
classes.STRONG: Prospective sample >=30, challenger better in Brier and Log Loss, and paired 95% CIs fully favorable.

definition: Evidence-only map of SPORT x COMPETITION x MARKET. Never a probability generator.
